description: E-ASSIGN-POSITION: `if (g((x = 1)) > 0)` — an argument, not the condition or an operand of it.
rationale: §50 amendment (S473 D10): the kept places are "the whole condition" and "a parenthesized operand of the condition"; "an assignment in any non-condition value position — … an argument (`f(x = 1)`)" is `E-ASSIGN-POSITION`.
